info.title: bmo-mail
info.description: Mailboxes read, written and watched behind one API, each account an owner's and of the kind whose adapter reaches it: accounts, folders, messages and threads, drafts and sends, labels, rules, spam senders and settings; the console face beside them is bmo-chat's and stated there. Every route the screen uses takes the role the reader holds in `Owner-Role` and the opaque owner key the caller acts for in `Owner-Key`; a route that reads or changes an account reaches that owner's accounts alone. A mailbox's members nest under its account. Bodies are JSON with camelCase keys; times are integers of epoch milliseconds. A list is a page; a page of messages is newest first with a message's `at` as its cursor, and the small lists are paged by `position`. A key holding a slash stands in a path percent-encoded. Every failure is answered in the error shape with its status. The harness plugin's tools, each a thin call of one route, are stated under `x-tools`.

x-harness.entry: A harness reads a mailbox with mail_messages and mail_thread, writes with mail_draft and mail_draft_update, and sends with mail_send.

RuleAction.description:
One action of a rule. The store holds it in this shape; a rule kept before its fields took their
names of today is read under the names it was kept with.

position.description: Its new place among the rules.

failure.description: Why it failed, in English; null unless it did.

sendAt.description: When it goes; after the account's undo span where null.

undoSendMs.description: How long a send waits before it goes: 0 to 30,000.

readReceipts.description: Whether a new draft asks for a read receipt.

showImages.description: Whether a message's outside pictures are shown as it opens.

spamSenders.description: Every always-spam sender; changed through its own route alone.

SettingsPatch.description: A change of an account's settings.

SpamSender.description: A sender always sent to spam.

messages.description: Oldest first, each with its bodies.

Authorization.description: An authorization started: where to send the browser.

returnTo.description: Where the provider sends the browser back to.

more.description: Whether anything stands past the last item.

id.description: The event's number, which only grows.

data.description: The member as a GET answers it, or its key alone for a deletion.

reason.description: Why the service is not ready; null while it is.

unreadCount.description: The unread messages of every reachable inbox together.

code.description: The kebab-case code a caller matches on.

error.description: The English sentence, for a log.

WireError.description: A failure, in the common error shape.

Error.description:
A failure, in the common error shape. The codes:
- `bad-request` (400): the body, the query or the path is not the shape the route takes
- `unauthorized` (401): the bearer token is missing or wrong
- `forbidden` (403): the role is missing or does not allow the screen's, or the owner key is missing
- `no-route` (404): no route answers this method and path
- `not-found` (404): nothing stands at the key the path names
- `conflict` (409): an account's or a label's name is taken, or a send has already gone
- `gone` (410): the events after the number asked for are no longer kept
- `too-large` (413): a file or a message is past the size the submission server takes
- `too-many-labels` (422): the account holds the most labels it may
- `flag-not-settable` (422): a flag is not one a request may set
- `unknown-label` (422): a body names a label the account does not hold
- `unknown-folder` (422): a body names a folder the mailbox does not hold
- `unknown-message` (422): a body names a message the account does not hold
- `outside-trash` (422): a message to delete is not in spam or trash
- `no-recipients` (422): a draft to send has no recipient
- `send-too-late` (422): a send's sendAt is past the undo span from now
- `no-receipt-asked` (422): the message asks for no read receipt
- `draft-not-placed` (422): the server did not say where it put a saved draft
- `unknown-kind` (422): a body names a kind of account the service does not declare
- `sign-in-failed` (422): the account's servers did not take its sign-in
- `no-authorization` (422): an authorization is asked for a kind that signs in by password
- `unknown-authorization` (422): a body names an authorization that is not the owner's, has run out or was used
- `failed` (500): the service failed
- `upstream-failed` (502): the mail server did not answer, or failed
- `not-ready` (503): the service has no key file to seal an account's secrets with

bearer.description: The service's token, from the caller's own configuration.

x-tools.name: mail_accounts
x-tools.description: The mail accounts: each one's name, which every other tool takes as accountName, its address and its inbox's unread count.

input.description: A small list's paging: by the position of the last item read.

after.description: The position of the last item read; the items after it.

limit.description: The most items the page holds; the whole list where none is given.

x-tools.name: mail_messages
x-tools.description: Messages of a folder, a label or matching search words, newest first, without their bodies. The next page is asked with before set to the last message's at.

input.description: A page of an account's messages.

folderName.description: The folder to read; the inbox where neither it, `q` nor `labelId` is given.

q.description:
Search words: `from:`, `to:`, `subject:`, `label:`, `in:`, `is:unread`, `is:starred`, `has:attachment`,
`before:` and `after:` with a date, and words of the text.

before.description: A message's `at`: the messages older than it.

after.description: A message's `at`: the messages newer than it.

x-tools.name: mail_message
x-tools.description: One message with its plain-text and HTML bodies and its parts.

x-tools.name: mail_update
x-tools.description: Change a message's flags or labels, or move it to a folder: flags and labelIds are the whole of what it should carry. A moved message answers under its new id.

input.description: A message's change: the whole of its flags and labels, and the folder to move it to.

flags.description:
Every flag it should hold among `\Seen`, `\Flagged`, `\Answered`, `$Forwarded`, `$Junk`, `$NotJunk` and
`$MDNSent`; one left out is taken off.

x-tools.name: mail_thread
x-tools.description: One conversation and its messages, oldest first, each with its bodies.

x-tools.name: mail_draft
x-tools.description: Start a draft, saved in the drafts folder at once: new, a reply (replyTo, with replyAll for every recipient) or a forward. Its id names it across every save.

replyTo.description: The message it answers, by its id.

replyAll.description: Whether it answers every recipient of `replyTo`.

forward.description: The message it carries, by its id.

x-tools.name: mail_draft_update
x-tools.description: Change a draft: each field given replaces the draft's own, recipients as name and address, the body as HTML. The draft is saved again under the same id.

input.description: A draft's change: each field given replaces the draft's own.

x-tools.name: mail_send
x-tools.description: Send a draft: it waits for the account's undo span, or until sendAt, and then goes; the answer's state is waiting.

sendAt.description:
When it goes, in epoch milliseconds, no later than the undo span from now; after the undo span where
absent.
